module.title: Deployment And Hosting Fundamentals
module.description: Learn how websites and fullstack applications are published online and made accessible to users worldwide.

lessons.title: What Is Deployment?

definition.title: Simple Definition
definition.content: Deployment is the process of publishing an application online so people can access it through the internet.

sections.heading: Why Deployment Exists
sections.content: Applications built on your computer are only accessible locally. Deployment makes them available worldwide.

sections.heading: Localhost vs Production
sections.content: During development, applications run locally on your device. Production means the app is live online.

sections.heading: Frontend And Backend Deployment
sections.content: Frontend and backend are usually deployed separately on hosting platforms.

sections.heading: Modern Applications Depend On Cloud Hosting
sections.content: Most applications today are hosted on cloud platforms instead of personal computers.

easyExample.title: Restaurant Opening Example
easyExample.content: Building a restaurant kitchen privately is development. Opening it for customers is deployment.

summary: Frontend and backend are deployed separately

definition.title: Simple Definition
definition.content: Frontend hosting makes website interfaces accessible online.

sections.heading: What Gets Hosted
sections.content: Frontend hosting serves HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and assets like images.

sections.heading: Modern Frontend Platforms
sections.content: Platforms like Vercel and Netlify automatically deploy frontend applications.

sections.heading: Automatic Deployment
sections.content: GitHub integration allows hosting platforms to deploy applications automatically after code updates.

sections.heading: Frontend Optimization
sections.content: Hosting platforms optimize frontend performance using caching and CDNs.

easyExample.title: Shopping Mall Example
easyExample.content: Frontend hosting is like placing your shop inside a mall so customers can access it easily.

definition.title: Simple Definition
definition.content: Backend hosting runs server-side applications online so APIs and databases can work globally.

sections.heading: Why Backend Needs Hosting
sections.content: Backend APIs must stay online continuously to handle requests from users.

sections.heading: Backend Servers
sections.content: Hosting platforms run backend code on servers connected to the internet.

sections.heading: Popular Backend Hosting Platforms
sections.content: Render, Railway, AWS, and DigitalOcean are commonly used backend hosting platforms.

sections.heading: Always Running Systems
sections.content: Production backend systems usually run continuously to serve users anytime.

easyExample.title: Call Center Example
easyExample.content: Backend hosting works like a call center staying active all day to handle requests from customers.

definition.title: Simple Definition
definition.content: Domains provide readable website names while DNS connects domains to servers.

sections.heading: Why Domains Exist
sections.content: Humans remember names more easily than IP addresses.

sections.heading: Custom Domains
sections.content: Applications use domains like google.com instead of server IP addresses.

sections.heading: DNS Connection
sections.content: DNS converts domain names into actual server addresses.

sections.heading: Professional Branding
sections.content: Custom domains improve trust and branding for applications.

easyExample.title: Contact List Example
easyExample.content: Your phone stores names while internally using phone numbers. Domains and DNS work similarly.

lessons.title: Environment Variables

definition.title: Simple Definition
definition.content: Environment variables securely store important configuration values outside application code.

sections.heading: Why Environment Variables Exist
sections.content: Sensitive information like API keys and database passwords should not be stored directly in code.

sections.heading: Security Benefits
sections.content: Environment variables help protect secrets from being exposed publicly.

sections.heading: Production Configurations
sections.content: Applications use different configurations in development and production environments.

sections.heading: Modern Applications Depend On Secrets
sections.content: Databases, APIs, cloud storage, and authentication systems all use environment variables.

easyExample.title: Locker Key Example
easyExample.content: Instead of leaving keys outside your house, you store them securely. Environment variables protect application secrets similarly.

summary: Modern systems depend on secure variables

definition.title: Simple Definition
definition.content: Production applications combine frontend, backend, databases, hosting, domains, and security together into real systems.

sections.heading: Frontend Deployment
sections.content: Frontend applications are deployed on hosting platforms and connected to domains.

sections.heading: Backend Deployment
sections.content: Backend APIs run on servers and communicate with databases.

sections.heading: Database Connectivity
sections.content: Production databases store real user information securely.

sections.heading: Real Application Architecture
sections.content: Modern systems connect frontend, backend, APIs, authentication, databases, and hosting together.

easyExample.title: Airport System Example
easyExample.content: Airports combine ticketing, security, flights, staff, and passengers into one connected system. Production apps work similarly.
